note: Adapted from Banks' 1919 original description (in English); only the soldier and worker are described (the worker inferred from the comparison with N. morio); no alate is described; type locality Jamaica (collected by Hubbard), also recorded from Caboda, Cuba (collected by Mann). The original gives only the head length as a soldier measurement.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Related to N. surinamensis, but without long hairs at the base of the nasus or along the margin of the pronotum, the vertex less convex than in that species, and the body paler. Soldier head broad with the top somewhat flattened as seen from the front; nasus large and very long, about as long as the head in lateral view; head length 1.7 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown, the nasus scarcely darker; anterior margin of the pronotum slightly brown, the rest of it and the abdominal dorsum pale yellow; antennae also pale yellow; legs pale. Head broad, the top distinctly somewhat flattened as seen from the front; nasus large and very long, about as long as the head in lateral view; 2 long bristles near the vertex, the hairs below the base of the nasus minute and almost invisible; the rest of the head with only very fine microscopic hairs, hardly visible to the naked eye; margin of the pronotum with only short hairs; abdomen with short hairs, each segment with longer erect bristles at the posterior margin; antennae long, segment 3 distinctly longer than segment 2, segments 4 and 5 shorter than segment 3 and about equal to segment 2, the following segments slightly longer. Measurements: head length 1.7 mm. The nest is built on the ground and is small.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Worker: upper sides of the head with the usual large dark patches, paler than in N. morio, each patch showing faint oblique lines running down from the vertex; head with many microscopic hairs.
